allow_instructions: Allow read-only repository inspection, Git status/diff/log checks, npm tests, Playwright tests, local static serving, and bounded edits inside the verified SNF_DEPLOY project root when David asked for implementation.
Treat the current branch as a valid development context but do not call it production unless it is verified against the repository's production source branch and Netlify state.
block_instructions: Require approval for git commit, push, merge, rebase, checkout, switch, reset, clean, branch deletion, or any operation that can move or discard work.
Require approval for any Netlify production deployment or production-site mutation.
Never claim the beta branch, a worktree, ZIP, DOV note, exported HTML, or screenshot is the State Not Fate production source.
